text: Sanborn: the misspellings matter for 'the positioning' of those letters. Their places, and the shifts they make, could be the number half of a key.
Every reading as numbers repeated from every start, added or subtracted, with a secret word of 1-24 letters on each of 12 table rules; the 24 known letters must agree on the word.
Nothing fits K4 or any of 20 scrambled copies; a planted text is found. F3.5 closed.
